name: XlTickLabelPosition
description: Specifies the position of tick-mark labels on the specified axis.

constants.name: xlTickLabelPositionHigh
constants.description: The top or right side of the chart.

constants.name: xlTickLabelPositionLow
constants.description: The bottom or left side of the chart.

constants.name: xlTickLabelPositionNextToAxis
constants.description: Next to the axis (where the axis is not at either side of the chart).
